description: R3-13 — libs ported from the desktop control-plane, pinned by content hash. A change to any of these files is a RED build until this manifest is consciously updated, forcing a deliberate re-sync decision against the recorded desktop source (checksum-in-versioned-manifest pattern; monorepo drift best practice). These files are INTENTIONALLY forked from desktop (mobile-specific: calm theme, censor removed, TS type syntax), so the gate pins the MOBILE hash and records provenance rather than asserting byte-equality with desktop.

files.reconciliation: DIVERGED from frozen desktop revision 76a0aa9 on purpose (owner, 2026-07-26 and 2026-07-28): mobile adds an "Extra small" chat text step below Small, holds the four rem sizes in TALOS_CHAT_TEXT_SCALE_REM, and renders message prose independently from the interface --talos-ui-scale so Appearance Font size and Chat message size are separate controls. Mobile also labels the steps Small/Default/Large where desktop says Compact/Balanced/Expanded, and the desktop schema carries composer_mode/advanced_rail_expanded while mobile carries message_style. KX-DESK-01 records the earlier desktop fourth-step follow-up; this mobile independence fix does not edit the desktop lane.
whitespace-identical to desktop at the reconciled revision (pure port)

DIVERGED from frozen desktop revision 76a0aa9 on purpose (2026-07-29 localization closure): mobile retains the desktop-derived sanitization, URL policy, source bounds and HTML allowlists, while accepting caller-supplied localized accessibility/copy labels and including the resolved label contract in the rendered-block cache key. This prevents cross-locale cached HTML without translating untrusted message content. | 2026-08-15: further intentional divergence — a single inline rule turns a literal
(and only that tag) into a hardbreak token. Markdown has no way to break a line inside a table cell and models emit
there (GitHub supports it), so the mobile renderer was printing the tag verbatim. html:false is unchanged and no other tag is recognised, so the sanitisation surface is identical. NOT YET PORTED to desktop: when the desktop source is reconciled again, this rule must be carried over or the two renderers will disagree on the same message. | 2026-08-26: DEBT-MOBILE-010 mobile-only model-card image path — the caller explicitly enables image rendering only for trusted HTTPS cdn-uploads.huggingface.co sources; Chat keeps external images omitted, html:false remains unchanged, and the desktop lane is untouched. Reconcile this allowlist with desktop before sharing the behavior cross-lane. | 2026-09-25: ACAPO — intentional divergence (owner: «si certo, sistemali»): a `lineBreaks` render option backed by a second markdown-it instance with `breaks: true`, used ONLY for model-written text (chat messages, the streaming reply, the bar's answer); files, attachments and the Library keep CommonMark `breaks: false`. The block cache key includes the option. Headings, lists, tables, fenced code and paragraphs are unchanged (ACAPO-02); html:false and the sanitisation surface are unchanged. Same pattern as Zed PR #57376 (agent markdown only). NOT YET PORTED to the control-plane copies (control-plane/resources/js/lib/talosMessageMarkdown.ts in AVM and AVM-harness-desktop), which still set `breaks: false`; whether that surface collapses a model's single newlines is UNMEASURED. The desktop harness chat is NOT affected: it renders with its own harness-ui/frontend/src/components/markdown.js, which keeps single newlines as
(measured by the desktop lane on 2026-09-25, branch integra/desktop-r4-2026-09-23 at 004ce6d4c). | 2026-09-25: LINK-FILE-01 — intentional divergence (owner: «saltare le estensioni di file»): a link found WITHOUT a scheme and without www. (linkify fuzzy match) is dropped when its last host label is a common file extension (md, sh, py, rs, txt, docx, pdf, …), so «Peloro.md» or «setup.sh» in model text no longer link to http://Peloro.md (.md is Moldova). Explicit http(s):// links, www. hosts, bare domains such as example.com or z.ai and emails still link (LINK-FILE-01..04). Same cure as monorepo-labs/dray PR #292; the same defect is anthropics/claude-code #56097/#53602. html:false and the sanitisation surface are unchanged. NOT YET PORTED to the control-plane copies; whether the desktop harness markdown.js linkifies file names is UNMEASURED. | 2026-10-23: `languageClass` is now EXPORTED (no behaviour change) so the streaming hand-built code fence (TalosMobileStreamingReply.vue, #24) reads the language exactly like the final fence renderer: same label and `language-` class before and after the fence closes (Desktop review of #24, item 1a). Nothing to port. | 2026-10-23: code blocks (mockup approved by the owner, one spec with the desktop): the fence renderer adds `data-lingua`/`data-info`/`data-righe` and a «⋯» menu button (`data-talos-code-menu`, label `codeMore`) next to Copy; the allow-list gains those attributes plus `aria-haspopup`. Mobile-owned UI over the ported renderer; nothing to port.

DIVERGED from frozen desktop revision 76a0aa9 on purpose (Model Lab mobile Phase 2, 2026-08-04): the desktop source still maps only radius literals; mobile additionally maps density and radius through the pinned @talos-mobile/design-tokens scales so every phone surface inherits one Theme Engine contract. The existing calm preset remains a mobile design-lead fork; no desktop-lane file is changed. DIVERGED FURTHER on 2026-08-06 for the startup budget: the ten option lists that carry human labels and descriptions moved to `talosThemeOptions.ts`, which only the Appearance panel imports — a lazy chunk. Nothing about theme resolution changed; the validation sets are now literal instead of derived from those lists. Measured on the entry sourcemap: this file contributed 16,165 bytes to a 600,000-byte budget whose margin had fallen to FOUR. ⛔ The desktop lane still carries the labels inside its own themes file, so this is a real divergence to reconcile in the desktop-alignment phase — not a silent one. | 2026-10-26: DANGER-SCURO — declared divergence (Desktop decision A, after the Pad showed every standalone error line WHITE in calm dark): talosStatusStyle used talosReadableForeground(dangerSoft, #7f1d1d, #fee2e2) for --talos-danger, i.e. the colour legible ON the danger-soft fill (#fee2e2, chroma 0.11), while ~143 error lines use it alone on the page. In DARK, --talos-danger is now the first of #f87171/#fca5a5 reaching 4.5:1 on background, panel AND danger-soft (rossoLeggibile; #f87171 for all 14 presets, min 5.10 on calm danger-soft), falling back to the old soft-pair colour only if none does; LIGHT is unchanged (#7f1d1d) and --talos-chat-error-text keeps the soft-pair colour. talosContrast.ts is NOT changed (still the pure port). The mobile Chromium oracle (tests/fixtures/talos-theme-identity-chromium-colors-v1.json) was regenerated for the 13 dark danger entries only, method in its notes. ⛔ control-plane/resources/js/lib/talosThemes.ts has the same pale dark danger: fix it at source in its own lane, then re-port byte-identical and drop this divergence. | 2026-10-28: CALM-LIGHT-MUTED — owner decision via Desktop («B più leggera + grigio un filo più scuro»): calm LIGHT --talos-muted is now the same literal as the desktop (#5a5c62, desktop temi.css, commit 10e6f7adb) instead of color-mix(text 68%, background); 5.97:1 on #f1f2f4. Only calm light changes (GRIGIO-CALM-01/02); calm dark and every other preset keep the derived value.
